audit_scope.actual_file: Complete two-unit actual file, every proof paragraph and final scope remark read.
checks: Normal equidimensional complete surfaces over perfect k have isolated singular locus; the continuous Jacobian condition is the formal isolated-smoothness hypothesis used by Artin. One algebraization is fixed for R before any cover.

Artin 3.11 applies to the fixed henselization and its maximal ideal, and includes all finite-algebra morphisms. Faithfully flat completion and henselian product decomposition preserve exactly the normal local domain subcategory. Generic degree is unchanged on the puncture.

Proper regular resolutions remain regular under completion by the precise Stacks closed-fibre theorem. Closed exceptional schemes, their thickened cycles, normal line bundles, intersection numbers and arithmetic genera are unchanged.

Flat coherent base change preserves finite-length geometric-genus cohomology. The same exceptional rational (-1) curves occur, so minimality and the complete intersection/canonical energy data are preserved.

The existing strict-henselian geometric-budget theorem uses one fixed base model and resolution, so its constants do not vary with the individual finite cover or etale neighbourhood. The final all-complete scope transfer does not assert a module atlas or hereditary representation count.
